feature: Assign each newly opened factory PR to the authenticated GitHub CLI account that opens it (plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-03-factory-pr-self-assignment-plan.md). Add `--assignee @me` to the PR creation step, keeping the human approval before push/PR. When creation or assignment reports an error, look up the branch's existing PR before retrying; if a PR exists but assignment failed, preserve its URL and report the assignment problem separately. Verify with a disposable GitHub repository: actual assignee, and resuming interrupted publication does not create a duplicate PR. Acceptance: new PR lists the authenticated gh account as assignee; a failed assignment is visible; a retry reuses an existing PR; approval flow never asks for a GitHub username.

commands.build: export FACTORY_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"; for h in claude-code opencode codex copilot zcode; do python3 tools/render.py "$h" || exit 1; done; bash -n install.sh

decisions.question: setup-commands
decisions.answer: build: render five harnesses + bash -n install.sh; test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools (README CI line)

decisions.question: Q1
decisions.answer: A: add --assignee @me to the single gh pr create call in step 9 (no separate gh pr edit); human Approve gate before push/PR unchanged; no GitHub username is ever asked

decisions.question: Q2
decisions.answer: A: make PR creation idempotent: before gh pr create and again after any non-zero exit, look up the branch's PR with gh pr view <branch> --json url,assignees; an existing PR is reused (URL recorded via set-status pr-open), never recreated

decisions.question: Q3
decisions.answer: A: assignment failure is non-blocking: when the PR exists but the authenticated account is not among its assignees, keep the URL, continue the run, and report the assignment problem separately in the final notice; no new state schema or issue kind

decisions.question: Q4
decisions.answer: A: resume of the pr stage (state.md Resume) follows the same lookup-then-create path, so interrupted publication never creates a duplicate PR

decisions.question: Q5
decisions.answer: A: automated verification = a text-contract test under tools/tests asserting step 9 carries --assignee @me, the existing-PR lookup and the separate assignment report; the disposable-GitHub-repo live check is written as a manual runbook in the spec's quickstart for the user, not executed by agents (creating GitHub repos is outward-facing)

decisions.question: Q6
decisions.answer: A: edit core only (core/skills/factory/SKILL.md step 9, core references/state.md Resume pr) and re-render dist for all five harnesses; no ADR, no CONTEXT.md term
